s: Dine tepillat musap beshabbat ubo h' seipim: zeman tepillat musap matchil miyyad achar tepillat hashshachar, ap im hitpallel shacharit babboqer miyyad achar shehiggia zemannah — yakol gam ken lehitpallel musap baet hahi, shezzeman haqrabat hammusap matchil miyyad achar haqrabat tamid babboqer:

Veen leacher tepillat musap yoter mishsheba shaot al hayom, dehaynu shaa achar chatzot, vehamacher kol kak niqra poshea, veap al pi ken yotze yede chobato, mippene shezzemannah kol hayyom. Apillu im kebar hitpallel mincha — chozer umitpallel musap, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim shakach velo hitpallel otah ad shechasheka — en lah tashlumin kemo sheyyesh lishar tepillot, kemo shennitbaer besimman q"ch:

Veim abar vehitpallel otah qodem shehitpallel shacharit — yatza, sheap sheqqorban musap shehiqribuhu qodem tamid shel shachar pasul, mikkol maqom bitpilla lo hechemiru kol kak lihyot chozer umitpallel, hoil vehitpallel otah beshaa hareuya lehaqraba:

Muttar litom achar tepillat shacharit qodem tepillat hammusapin, kemo shemmuttar litom qodem tepillat hammincha mishshehiggia zemannah, dehaynu akilat perot apillu harbeh kede lisod halleb, upat kebetza velo yoter, kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"b. Ubilbad sheyyeqaddesh mittechilla, veyishteh rebiit yayin o yokal kezayit mechameshet hamminin achar haqqiddush miyyad, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"g:

Hayu lepanayv shette tepillot, achat shel mincha veachat shel musapim, kegon sheechar lehitpallel musap ad shehiggia zeman hammincha, dehaynu shesh shaot umechetza — tzarik lehitpallel shel mincha techilla, lepi shehi tedira yoter mittepillat hammusapim, vekol hattadir et chabero — qodem et chabero. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshetztzarik atta lehitpallel shettehen, kegon sherotzeh leekol seudda gedola o qetanna, veasur lo leekol qodem sheyyitpallel mincha kemo shennitbaer besimman rl"b — azay tzarik lehaqdimah. Abal im eno tzarik kelal atta lehitpallel mincha — yakol lehaqdim shel musap. Bameh debarim amurim? Kesheadayin lo higgia zeman mincha qetanna, shehi iqqar tepillat hammincha, abal mishshehiggia iqqar zemannah — tzarik lehaqdimah bekol inyan. Veyesh omerim sheapillu qodem mincha qetanna tzarik lehaqdim mincha bekol inyan. Veyesh lachush ledibrehem, velizzaher beyom hakkippurim shemmaarikim bitpillat shacharit, sheyyatchilu musap qodem shesh umechetza, kede shello yitztareku lehitpallel mincha techilla lepi sebara zo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tr"k. Umikkol maqom, im era sheheeriku beshacharit ad achar shesh umechetza, vaapillu im era shello hitchilu musap ad shehiggia zeman mincha qetanna — lo yitpalelu mincha techilla betzibbur, kede shello yitu hehamon laasot ken paam acheret. Velo ameru lehitpallel mincha techilla ella beyachid sheera lo ken:
